courseleaf.title: Sustainable Transportation Engineering (STE)
courseleaf.text:
STE 298 — Selected Topics in Sustainable Transportation Engineering (1-15 units)

Course Description: Group study.

Prerequisite(s): Consent of Instructor.

  • Learning Activities: Variable 1-15 hour(s).
  • Enrollment Restriction(s): Restricted to students enrolled in the Sustainable Transportation Engineering M.Eng. program.
  • Repeat Credit: May be repeated when topic differs.
  • Grade Mode: Letter.
  • This course version is effective from, and including: Fall Quarter 2026.
